name: Sacred Fire
label: Quest
description: Hunters seek Incendia Agave at the Boiling Pool to prepare a sacred fire that can call Arikara from the canyons of Thousand Needles.

clips.title: The story
paras: Hunters seek Incendia Agave at the Boiling Pool to prepare a sacred fire that can call Arikara from the canyons of Thousand Needles.

Motega Firemane instructs hunters to prepare the sacred fire of life, an ancient flame that calls the spirit beast Arikara. The monstrous wind serpent cannot simply be tracked across the canyon floor; she must be drawn to the fire. The flame needs more than ordinary kindling. Rare Incendia Agave, which grows around the scalding waters of Thousand Needles, feeds it.

Incendia Agave grows near the Boiling Pool, below Darkcloud Pinnacle. To gather the spiky plants, you brave blistering waters and steam elementals drifting through the mists. Many bushels grow beneath the surface, where the hot lake water tests every hunter sent to collect them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.

Go now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a powerful shaman that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.
Travel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So, Motega Firemain sends word of Arikara...well now that is grave news.
Arikara is a deadly creature born only to seek vengeance against those who have committed heinous acts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good, you have gathered the essential amount of Incendia agave. This rare herb found only in Thousand Needles will help light the dormant sacred fire of life.
